steps.claim: The twisted label of c_i is a label of degree |r| (a label with roots scaled by a unit).

Take γ the tame generator at A. For s in inertia take a tame exponent y of s (exists_isTameExponent) and μ = the ιℓT(x)^y over the roots x (with multiplicity) of (twisted label)·(X − 1)^t, |μ| = |r| + t. For a labelled column R with these labels, the labelled clause at A gives that ∏_{y∈μ}(X − y) kills s at A, and local_clauses_of_conjPlace (R conjugate self-dual) gives the killing of conj(s⁻¹) at the conjugate place. The properties of each y ∈ μ remain.

    [placesAboveG]) hA).1).2.2 s u _ k⟩) ((congrArg prod (map_map ..)).substr (N.labelled H))⟩⟩
